caption: The drawing shows a geometric pattern composed of four square blocks, each featuring an arrangement of interlocking oval and petal shapes. Three of the blocks are filled with a red background covered in a small black and white grid of diamond shapes. The fourth block, located in the bottom left, has a reddish-brown background with a floral pattern of small pink, green, and white flowers. The petal and oval shapes that intersect in each block are cream or tan in color and outlined by fine dark lines, with the inner sections filled with parallel lines that add texture. The four blocks are arranged in a two-by-two grid and contained within a rectangular border, itself decorated with a multicolored edge. Below the main composition, there is a single square swatch with the same reddish-brown floral pattern as seen in the bottom left block of the main drawing. The background of the entire drawing is a light beige color, and at the bottom right, there is a handwritten label that says "¼ of quilt."
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
